subject: zeroclaw
title: The merge-gating CI 'eval gate' is scripted replay against a stubbed model, not a model eval - verification ceiling stays the frozen 8
one_why: Decides the band: the main review's 8.5 turned 'an eval ran in CI' into credit above the errata's 8-ceiling, but TraceLlmProvider replays canned LlmTrace steps - the same scripted-mock-provider design that pins codex at 8 (scripted SSE servers); live/capability suites are planned, not wired, so crediting it inverts the ladder. Nuance over the canonical evals-in-ci id: here the harness IS in CI, which is exactly what makes the letter/spirit split worth recording.

subject: zeroclaw
title: Five fuzz targets exist but no workflow ever runs them; three of five fuzz serde itself
evidence: fuzz/fuzz_targets/ (fuzz_command_validation.rs, fuzz_config_parse.rs, fuzz_provider_response.rs, fuzz_tool_params.rs, fuzz_webhook_payload.rs); grep -rn fuzz .github/workflows/ = 0 hits
one_why: The missing-fuzzing half of the verification 9-gate is self-inflicted and cheap: wiring one cron job over the existing targets (at minimum fuzz_command_validation, the only non-serde one) is the smallest step separating this tree from the 8-ceiling; serde-fuzzing targets would not clear the gate anyway.

subject: zeroclaw
title: Census blind to Rust inline #[cfg(test)]: test_loc understated ~15x (34,710 vs 543,372 measured) and non_test_loc overstated ~1.8x (1,063,392 vs 591,948)
evidence: brace-matched walk of all 1,163 .rs files (this review): inline 543,372 + standalone 41,534 + production 591,948; census.json zeroclaw row
one_why: New census archetype for the family: not fixtures inflating tests (deepagents/acr) but inline-test blindness deflating them while the same walk charges them to production - any glob-based census on a Rust monorepo with inline tests will mis-rank test-to-prod ratios AND tier both ways; census needs a cfg(test) aware pass for Rust.

subject: zeroclaw
title: SECURITY.md presents five 'Sandboxing Layers' without disclosing that the OS-sandbox layer is absent by default off macOS
evidence: SECURITY.md:50-58; default features Cargo.toml:242-248 exclude sandbox-landlock/sandbox-bubblewrap (:349-350); NoopSandbox fallback detect.rs:350,390,398
one_why: The layers listed are real code but conditional - default Linux builds get a kernel sandbox only if firejail/docker happen to be installed, else NoopSandbox; pi's SECURITY.md:50 ('intentionally does not have a sandbox') is the disclosure bar. Inside the scored 7.5, kept as a finding because disclosure prominence is the difference between honest and misleading posture docs.
